audit.why: 54.25% over 811 games. Pantheon owns 1-5, Naafiri takes 6 and first item (R + lethality spike), Pantheon returns at two bruiser items. Content win[] and packet agree; full sides were blanket 'Skill'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was attributed to 'Call of the Pack' as her ult across whys[3], whys[4], spikes[1], mid, late and wants.foe[0]. Her ult is Hounds' Pursuit; The Call of the Pack is her W (26s basic ability, untargetable + pack empower).
audit.why: Kit file is authority: R = Hounds' Pursuit 110/95/80s (lock-on pack dash, recast grants shield); W = The Call of the Pack (untargetable, more packmates, MS/AD).
audit.corrected: See edits — every reference realigned to the real slots.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field had no numbers; her W untargetability (dodges Pantheon's timed burst) unmentioned; dos/donts bodies were pasted trade lines; 10 fields misgendered her as he/his.
audit.why: W Shield Vault is point-and-click and interrupts her dashes; her W untargetability (26s) eats a mistimed combo — wait it out. Her Q needs both daggers for the bleed-amp burst, giving a punishable cast tell.

edits.before: - Naafiri Hounds’ Pursuit: matchup-defining — The lock-on pack dash starts her dive — stand near minions to body-block the hounds. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Aegis Assault has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: Through levels 3 to 5 you should be pressing your advantage: your full W-Q-E out-trades her pre-ult kit, and her dogs die to your E block plus AoE. Slow-push and look for the all-in before she hits 6, because that's your cleanest window. Track her ultimate — the moment Call of the Pack is available, the duel math flips against you. Bank a lead now so her level-6 spike doesn't put you behind.

edits.before: At 6 and into her first item, Naafiri is favored: Call of the Pack's extra packmates, healing, and move speed let her out-sustain and out-stick you, and a lethality item makes her burst lethal. Don't force isolated 1v1s in this window — trade with your jungler, take safe waves, and wait it out. Two items deep the phase swings back: your bruiser core (Black Cleaver, Sundered Sky) lets you eat the pack and survive to land W-Q, out-scaling her falling burst. Play for the comeback fight once you're tanky enough to live through her ult.
